intended_behavior: Modify this method to always convert the formatted content blocks into a single string joined appropriately (e.g., with newlines) instead of returning a list/array of content blocks in the "content" field of the tool message. This conversion should serialize JSON content blocks using json.dumps and extract text content directly as strings, preserving all original information. This will fix compatibility issues with OpenAI-compatible endpoints that require string content for tool messages, while maintaining the existing support for various content block types and the overall message structure.
